verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting and Suggestions products provide AI-generated analysis (Ask AI natural-language queries like 'Why are customers requesting refunds?'), automatic knowledge-gap detection with content draft suggestions, and Watchtower's AI-driven flagging of custom criteria — all surfaced directly inside the product from the user's own data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and more detail on breadth/accuracy of generated insights across data types.
